verification: Confirm executable identity, per-artifact time semantics, UTC conversion, and corroborating process logs where available.
limits: Amcache or ShimCache presence alone does not prove execution. Prefetch may be disabled or absent.

verification: Match SID, account, logon type, workstation, Logon ID, and timestamps. Distinguish authentication from interactive login.
limits: Success/failure status and logging coverage depend on event settings; events may be absent or cleared.

verification: Check MFT record vs path, timestamps, metadata flags, deletion semantics and retrieved bytes/hash.
limits: Deleted record does not imply content recoverability. MFT timestamps can be updated independently.

topic: USB device insertion and user attribution
verification: Correlate device serial, volume GUID, user artifact and timestamps; do not infer copying from plug-in alone.
limits: Insertion, mounting, file copying and execution are distinct events.

tools: Volatility 3: windows.info, windows.pslist, windows.pstree, windows.cmdline, windows.netscan, windows.malfind
verification: Match process identity, parent-child, PID recycling, command lines and network records; manual validation of code pages.
limits: Plugin availability and symbol resolution vary; malfind output is a lead, not malware verdict.

verification: Link request to response and payload bytes, source/destination and period; verify extraction hash if file reconstructed.
limits: DNS query or TCP SYN alone cannot prove exfiltration. TLS ciphertext may require lawful, provided keys.

verification: Check QNAME, response, rcode, original requester and time; link to follow-on network flow before calling it C2.
limits: Domain resolution does not show successful HTTP session, malware execution or data transfer.

topic: Disk image, partitions and filesystem recovery
verification: Compute sector-to-byte offset explicitly; hash exported contents, not original disk image; preserve source read-only.
limits: Raw memory and raw disk can look similar by filename; magic alone cannot classify every raw dump.

verification: Map URL/download records and browser profile, account and timestamp encoding, inspect WAL and deleted records when supported.
limits: Encrypted credentials cannot be recovered solely from a SQLite table; do not edit the original database.

tools: journalctl --file on a copy where supported
verification: Correlate user, timestamps, command execution and config modifications. Preserve log provenance.
limits: Shell history is incomplete and user-controlled; config presence does not prove execution.

verification: Verify signature and decoded data hashes; track bytes and offsets; record recovery operations on copies.
limits: Missing headers are not proof of format; archive member listings are not extraction or integrity tests.

verification: Confirm extracted bytes/metadata and format; compare false-positive candidates with ground truth.
limits: zsteg is not a generic JPEG solver; metadata is not inherently malicious.

verification: Separate static candidate IOCs from observed execution; decode using reproducible transformations, verify against host logs.
limits: Strings and YARA hits do not prove malicious behavior; do not execute an unknown sample on analysis host.

verification: Require explicit time encoding and timezone for naive datetime; retain raw values and source row IDs.
limits: Identical timestamps need not mean simultaneous actions. Naive times without timezone must not be silently normalized.

verification: Validate embedded file types and hashes, distinguish metadata from user actions and documents from active scripts.
limits: Macro presence alone does not prove execution; some PDF parsers modify extraction output only.
